niche: Mind Hacks, AI Secrets, Bizarre Body Science & Hidden Power Dynamics

ideas.title: The Paralyzed Tongue Glitch
ideas.angle: An interactive physical challenge where the viewer tries to say a specific phrase while holding their tongue. It creates a hilarious 'glitch' effect that forces people to comment their failed attempts and share the video.
ideas.reason: Interactive physical 'failures' have the highest VVSA because viewers must try it immediately. The 'Impossible' archetype is currently trending on TikTok and YouTube Shorts as it triggers a competitive reflex.
sources: The Stroop Effect in Motor Control

ideas.title: The 5-Second Triangle Trap
ideas.angle: A visual speed test where viewers must count triangles in a complex image. Because of how the brain shortcuts visual processing, 90% of people get the same wrong answer, leading to massive debate in the comments.

hook.en: Your brain is lying to you.

ideas.reason: Visual puzzles with a 'trick' answer achieve >105% APV because viewers rewatch the video to find what they missed. Disagreement in the comments drives the algorithm to push it to a wider audience.

ideas.title: The 1-Second Dominance Trick
ideas.angle: A dark psychology micro-behavior hack. It shows how one specific eyebrow movement during a greeting can instantly flip the power dynamic in a room. Viewers are prompted to 'try this tomorrow' and subscribe for more power plays.
ideas.reason: Social survival and 'status' hacks are high-velocity topics. Practical, actionable micro-expressions have a high 'save' rate, which YouTube uses as a key signal for viral potential.
sources: Paul Ekman: Facial Action Coding System (FACS)
Joe Navarro: What Every Body is Saying
